req.title: Session persists across requests
req.statement: The system shall keep session['user_id'] populated across requests until logout for authenticated users.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session should persist across requests for authenticated users until logout. This involves ensuring that the session['user_id'] is maintained correctly. The tests will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_session_persists_after_login
preconditions: User 'test' is registered in the database
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Access the index page
r = client.get('/')

# Assert session persists and HTTP 200
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'test title' in r.data

tests.name: test_session_cleared_on_logout
expected: User is redirected to login page
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Log out
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Access the index page
r = client.get('/')

# Assert session is cleared and redirected
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_session_persistence_boundary
preconditions: User 'test' is registered in the database
actions: Access the index page multiple times
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Access the index page multiple times
for _ in range(3):
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'test title' in r.data
